title: Persia to Iran in 50 seconds
ticker: From Persia to Iran: the civilisation that refuses to forget

scenes.title: Why Iran never forgets
scenes.say: Empires fall. Iran remembers. Here's the whole story in under a minute.

scenes.title: The King of Kings
scenes.say: It began as 240 kingdoms bound by language and faith. When one rose, it ruled the rest without erasing them: the Shahanshah, the King of Kings.
scenes.speak: It began as two hundred and forty kingdoms bound by language and faith. When one rose, it ruled the rest without erasing them: the Shahanshah, the King of Kings.

scenes.title: Every conqueror was absorbed
scenes.say: Alexander conquered it, and adopted its ways. The Arab conquest brought two centuries of silence. Turks and Mongols came, and became Persian kings.

scenes.title: Pars, Fars, Parsi
scenes.base: India's Parsis kept the old word
scenes.say: Arabic has no P, so Pars became Fars. But the Zoroastrians who fled to India kept the old name: Parsi.

scenes.title: Sovereignty, tested
scenes.say: 1935: Persia becomes Iran. 1953: a coup topples its elected leader. 1979: revolution.
scenes.speak: Nineteen thirty-five: Persia becomes Iran. Nineteen fifty-three: a coup topples its elected leader. Nineteen seventy-nine: revolution.

scenes.title: Silence, or renewal?
scenes.say: Now, under pressure again, Iran faces a choice it has faced before: silence, or renewal. It measures history in centuries.
